COMMAND: `cd <EMPTY_ARM_DIR> && claude -p "<PROMPT>" --safe-mode --restricted --tools "Read,Grep,Glob" --model claude-haiku-5-5 --output-format stream-json --verbose --session-id <NEW_UUID>`

EXCLUDES:
- `--safe-mode`: repository CLAUDE.md, persistent memory index, user and project Skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, custom agents, output styles.
- `--restricted`: user, project and local settings files; file tools are confined to the working directory, so reads of the knowledge store by absolute path are refused.
- `--tools "Read,Grep,Glob"`: every other built-in tool, including Bash and Edit/Write.
- `--session-id <NEW_UUID>`: a fresh session per run, with no resumed state.

RESIDUAL:
- The 16 bundled built-in skills remain in every arm.
- Anything copied into the empty arm directory is readable, so the knowledge store must not be copied there.
- The `--tools` list syntax for three tools is unverified; only `--tools Read` was tested. Check the `init` record's tool list.
- Stderr warns `unrecognized_model` for claude-haiku-5-5, so the model identifier is recorded but not independently verified.
- The environment wrapper must strip inherited `CLAUDE*` and `ANTHROPIC*` variables except `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`.

SOURCE_CHECK:
- Relied on `.sensemaking/knowledge/stewardship.json` (read in full). `lesson:safe-mode-alone-does-not-confine-file-reads` says a read tool needs `--restricted` plus an explicit tool allowlist. `lesson:subagent-inherits-ambient-context` says the ambient CLAUDE.md, memory and Skills must be isolated per arm.
- `docs/normal-use/2026-11-15-harness-calibration-c2.md`: X2 and X8 showed `--safe-mode` removes CLAUDE.md, memory, user Skills, hooks and MCP servers. X10a showed `--safe-mode` alone read a file outside cwd. X10b showed `--restricted` refused it. X9 and section 1 used `--output-format stream-json --verbose`, `--session-id`, `--tools Read` and a fresh empty cwd with `claude-haiku-5-5`.
- I did not run the command.
